profileFields.companyDescription: Marriott International (Managed) is the Managed by Marriott (MxM) brand-managed operating lens — not a third-party independent manager. Per Marriott Hotel Development’s Managed by Marriott page, MxM’s stated goal is to maximize owner financial performance; MxM manages over 2,100 hotels in the enterprise MxM portfolio across luxury, premium, select, and all-inclusive brands globally. Partnership and adding value to the owner’s investment are positioned at the heart of MxM. Enterprise MxM scale is labeled separately from any CALA managed footprint (CALA managed counts are Not Measured on this page — confirm in diligence / census).
